# Lifestyle editor (gui/ucm_lifestyle.gui, generated by tools/gen_lifestyle.py).

# Scope = player; scope:ucm_lifestyle_target is the character to edit.
ucm_open_lifestyle_gui_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:ucm_lifestyle_target }
		set_variable = { name = ucm_lifestyle_target value = scope:ucm_lifestyle_target }
		remove_character_flag = ucm_lifestyle_open
		add_character_flag = ucm_lifestyle_open
	}
}

ucm_close_lifestyle_gui_effect = {
	remove_character_flag = ucm_lifestyle_open
}

# Scope = the edited character.
ucm_lifestyle_toggle_perk_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_perk = $PERK$ }
		remove_perk = $PERK$
	}
	else = {
		add_perk = $PERK$
	}
}

# For a perk that grants a trait: removing the perk alone would leave the trait behind.
ucm_lifestyle_toggle_trait_perk_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_perk = $PERK$ }
		remove_perk = $PERK$
		remove_trait = $TRAIT$
	}
	else = {
		add_perk = $PERK$
		add_trait = $TRAIT$
	}
}
